dataset.label_definition: Files are labelled by the number of bug-fix commits (subject matches fix/bug/regression/crash/…) that touched them in the two years after the snapshot. Low = no bug-fix commits; Medium = 1–2 bug-fix commits; High = 3 or more.

models.name: Logistic Regression
models.description: Multinomial logistic regression with L2 regularisation and balanced class weights. Fast, interpretable linear baseline.

models.name: Random Forest
models.description: 400 bootstrapped decision trees with balanced class weights; captures non-linear interactions between metrics.

models.name: Gradient Boosting
models.description: Histogram-based gradient-boosted trees (scikit-learn's LightGBM-style HistGradientBoostingClassifier) with balanced class weights.

models.name: Support Vector Machine
models.description: SVC with an RBF kernel and Platt-scaled probabilities; learns a non-linear decision boundary in the scaled feature space.

models.name: Monotonic GBDT
models.description: Two monotonically constrained gradient-boosting models combined as an ordinal classifier (Frank & Hall). More size or complexity can never lower the predicted risk, so explanations stay consistent with software-engineering knowledge. Default for analysis.
